mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 5% over three consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 5% for two consecutive months indicates a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and input costs, ultimately compressing profit margins and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 of more than 2% signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO above its 12-month moving average by more than 1.5% for three consecutive months signals improving industrial production, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are not significantly positive (> +0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both UNRATE and PAYEMS above their respective 12-month averages signals robust labor market expansion, which increases consumer spending and corporate profitability, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are not significantly positive (> +0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A coordinated decline in both GDPC1 and HOUST below their 6-month moving averages for two consecutive months signals weakening housing and overall demand, which reduces equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < 6-mo MA and HOUST < 6-mo MA for 2 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp one-month increase in FEDFUNDS by more than 0.75 percentage points signals an unexpected tightening, raising short-term rates and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: immediate reaction to surprise rate hike
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in INDPRO above its 5-year moving average by more than 2% for four consecutive months signals a supply-side expansion, which boosts earnings and justifies higher equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, except during periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 4%).
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 5-yr MA +2% for 4 months and CPIAUCSL YoY <= 4%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are not significantly positive (> +1%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes with CPIAUCSL YoY <= 4%.
